LanguageData.DMS_ChunkSlag.label: automatroid debris
LanguageData.DMS_ChunkSlag.description: The remains of a destroyed automatroid. While useless in its current form, it can be smelted to recover resources.
LanguageData.DMS_ChunkSlag_Old.label: ancient automatroid debris
LanguageData.DMS_ChunkSlag_Old.description: The remains of an ancient automatroid, probably from a previous colonial fleet or the pioneer scouts of the past. Badly deformed and heavily rusted, but it can still be smelted or disassembled for usable resources.
